statement: For every continuous first cocycle A in Z1(G_Q,3 Z_3(1)), the geometric-conjugacy fiber of global sections of the actual quotient H is homeomorphic to the inverse system of completed units of its affine finite etale root algebras under their actual norm maps, with total norm a cube. Rational A=3 kappa(a) gives Q[X]/(X^(3^n)-a^3). The explicit norm systems X_n^r(1-X_n)^(3z) give a two-parameter family, injective for a=2, whose toric image is (kappa(a),r kappa(a)+z kappa(1-a^3)). The a=2 fields and tower maps are fully specified.
where_proved: sections/E_norm_sections.tex, E46.1-E46.24 and the complete proof; exact finite certificates in code/e_norm_sections.py/.out/.json
manuscript_passages: Section51.16, folios733v-736v, scans172-178, equations(371)-(379), Part E(c),(d)
notes: Coefficient map J_A -> Lambda_A -> F_3(1) is augmentation modulo3; H0(Q,F_3(1))=0 gives an injection and exactly the total-norm cube kernel.
Finite positional Shapiro is written at cocycle level with inverse c_z; c_z=c+delta m. Pushforward is the norm by the product-of-conjugate Kummer-root formula.

At every positional level H0 of the Tate-twisted permutation lattice is zero. Compatible classes are aligned by lifted bounding elements; bounding elements of zero classes agree uniquely. Thus no lim1H0 is discarded and no surjectivity of multiplicative norms is assumed.
Uniform continuous-cochain quotient topology is compared with finite positional and power-class topologies. Completed field multiplicative groups are not assumed compact.
First-coordinate transport is the actual translation i -> i+s and multiplication by T^s. The raw H coordinates map to toric coordinates by (a,v) -> (a/3,aug(v)/3).
The natural field action corresponds to inverse deck translation; its exact coboundary identity is included.

For a=2 the two field branches are Q(2^(1/3^(n-1))) and Q(2^(1/3^(n-1))*zeta_(3^n)); both transition maps cube their displayed generator. The second contains Q(zeta_3), and Eisenstein at2 proves both degrees.
The result classifies sections of H. The kernels from the intrinsic metabelian and marked groups are retained from E38.9, and lifting through them is not asserted.
